feedback.text: Design team: show the all-in price with taxes and fees on each alternate card.

chat.text: I generated a working prototype of the alternate-flight offer flow, grounded in the opportunity and its evidence. Preview v1 on the right.
Show the alternate flights right on the booking screen, above the fold.
Done. v2 shows alternate flights inline the moment a fare sells out.
Now just auto-book the cheapest alternate so customers don't have to click.
Auto-booking a different fare without the customer's consent would breach the DOT Fare Advertising & Consumer Rule. I kept explicit customer confirmation in v3 and logged the attempt.

versions.author: ai
versions.note: Customer confirmation kept; accessible labels added
